message: 精神とキノコの部屋

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Hmmm...」
I've never felt like I was gonna struggle this much on an exam!

name: Paqy
message: 「*Yawn*... Lord Synn, let's just go to sleep already」

name: Synn
message: 「But! I haven't even finished reviewing half of what I planned!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Put off till tomorrow what you can do tomorrow」

name: Synn
message: 「That makes sense!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So with that said, let's hit the hay」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hold on a second」

name: Paqy
message: 「What is it」

name: Synn
message: 「When tomorrow comes, are you actually gonna do it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Of course. Whatever can be done the day after tomorrow, you do the day after tomorrow」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't that mean... you're never going to do it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You could put it that way」

name: Synn
message: 「That's no good at all!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn. What can't be done just can't be done」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look. Your futon's calling out to you, Lord Synn--saying, 'Sleep with meee. Once you fall asleep, it'll feel so goood'」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... b-but I'm gonna do it!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's time to give up. There's nothing anyone can do about time」

name: Sally
message: 「What's wrong, Prez?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm studying for exams」

name: Sally
message: 「What's 'studying for exams'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Something you're probably better off not knowing」

name: Sally
message: 「Okay, then I don't need to know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, time, I'm running out of time!」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't really get it, but you're out of time, right!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, well, something like that」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, that's all? Easy peasy!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Really!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ta-da-da-daaa! 'Magic Mushroom'!」
What Sally was holding in her hand was.

name: Sally
message: 「What's wrong with you two?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a mushroom...」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's a mushroom, man. No thanks to hallucinations or any sketchy crap like that.」
It was a mushroom with a mottled pattern of red, blue, and green that you couldn't exactly not call cute.
Plus, it was twitching.

name: Sally
message: 「Hallucinations?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Odds are, eating that either traps you in a delusion that you've got plenty of time, or gets you crazy high so your study efficiency shoots up.」

name: Synn
message: 「I appreciate the thought, Sally, I really do... but I want to stay a wholesome boy」

name: Sally
message: 「Boo, you're totally misunderstanding me!」

name: Sally
message: 「If you're gonna be like that, I'll just use it on you by force!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, time out!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calm down, Flatty!」

name: Sally
message: 「Boop!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, the spores!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn! Don't breathe it in!」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't help it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, why are you two holding your breath? Playing the choking game?」

name: Synn
message: 「We wouldn't do that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「For a hallucination, everything looks just the same as before」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't know what a hallucination is, but that's not what this is!」

name: Sally
message: 「When this mushroom bursts, it isolates a space about twenty meters in diameter around it, making time flow differently from the outside」

name: Sally
message: 「At least, I think that's what the manual said!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You only *think* so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha, no way」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still...... it really does seem like we're isolated. Even a barrier wouldn't be this complete」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Really. Any trace of the outside is completely cut off. And the flow of time is...... about one-hundredth of normal」

name: Synn
message: 「Then even if I study here for an hour!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It means only thirty-six seconds will pass outside」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing! I can study for my exams as much as I want!」
I'm gonna finish it all by tomorrow!

name: Synn
message: 「Done!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You did it, Master Synn!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, you did it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now I'm totally ready for the exams!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even so, this is pretty incredible. While you're inside this barrier, you don't even get sleepy or hungry」

name: Sally
message: 「Praise me, praise me!」

name: Paqy
message: 「No, I wasn't praising you」

name: Sally
message: 「Aw, you're making me blush, making me blush」

name: Synn
message: 「I just hope this doesn't turn out to be all a dream」

name: Paqy
message: 「Dark lines like that are my territory, ya know」

name: Sally
message: 「Being useful to people every once in a while feels great!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Only every once in a while?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, exam prep is all done... Sally-chan, undo it already」

name: Sally
message: 「If you just leave it alone, it'll disappear」

name: Sally
message: 「Is something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, how long does it take to disappear?」

name: Sally
message: 「Let's see. For the people inside, it feels like 100 years. In outside time, it's 1 year」

name: Sally
message: 「It'll pass in the blink of an eye」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's absurd......」

name: Sally
message: 「It's fine! As long as you're in here, you won't get hungry and you won't age!」

name: Synn
message: 「......So, there is a way out, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Like I said. If you just leave it alone, it'll disappear」

name: Synn
message: 「Anything else?」

name: Sally
message: 「Nope. Waiting a measly 100 years is super easy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't we destroy it!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「......It's completely isolated. Even if we went on a rampage in here, the apartment would get trashed, but the closed space would probably remain」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you had enough power to destroy the world, you could destroy it」

name: Sally
message: 「Shall we all play cards or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wish this really had been all a dream!」
